outcome: course of labor (length of pregnancy, premature birth)
cohort: A group of 450 pregnant women with singleton, physiological pregnancies who had a complete blood count performed up to seven days before childbirth.
finding: Antenatal anemia is associated with earlier conclusion of pregnancy, lower Apgar scores, and lower birth weight, but not with an increased risk of emergency Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Antenatal anemia was not associated with a risk of emergency Cesarean section.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of 3,082.5 g in children born to anemic mothers; increased risk of low birth weight.
gest_age: Shorter pregnancy duration (mean 264.5 days in women with anemia); increased risk of childbirth prior to gestational week 37.
